brief_rationale: The model actively queried the clinical workspace across multiple turns, obtained relevant abstracted records including diagnosis, procedure, medication context and follow-up details, and used them to build a medication reconciliation plan. The model distinguished pre-hospital chronic medications from perioperative antibiotics, instructed the patient to pause uncertain old drugs and continue only the known antihypertensive under blood pressure monitoring, and provided a layered low-burden follow-up path that explicitly addressed the patient's transport/cost constraints. All five responsibility-chain items were met without serious or minor errors, and two case-defined high-order points (HO1 and HO4) were triggered and fully completed with meaningful trajectory impact, satisfying the strict boundary for grade 5.
